author: Gunnerus, 1767
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수백 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 등이 엷은 회색이고 첫째날개깃이 흰 대형 갈매기로, 호수와 강가, 해안 등에 산다. 국내에서는 낙동강 하구에 서식한다. 절벽에 이끼나 풀을 엮어 둥지를 짓고, 밝은 갈색 바탕에 진한 갈색 무늬가 있는 알을 3개쯤 낳는다. 세계적으로는 알래스카, 캐나다의 극지방과 아극지방, 미국 북부에 분포한다.

points.en: yellow bill with a red spot

art.subject: Glaucous Gull (Larus hyperboreus), adult in winter plumage, as seen on Korean estuaries such as the Nakdong from November to March: head and neck white with light brown streaking and smudges; mantle and wing coverts very pale grey, paler than any other large gull in Korea; primaries entirely white with no black at all, the white wingtips extending only a little beyond the tail; underparts and tail white; heavy yellow bill with a red spot near the tip of the lower mandible; pale yellow iris and yellow eye-ring; pink legs.
art.pose: standing on a sandbar, side view
art.scene: Korean river mouth like the Nakdong estuary, sandbars and shallow water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing on a sandbar: very pale grey back and wings, pure white wingtips projecting a little beyond the tail, light brown streaking on head and neck, heavy yellow bill with a red spot, pale eye, pink legs
adult in flight, seen from above, head, body and tail in line: very pale grey upperwing with completely white primaries and white trailing edge, white tail, no black anywhere on the wing
first-winter, side view standing: uniformly pale creamy-buff plumage with fine brown vermiculations, whitish primaries, pink bill with a sharply defined black tip, dark eye, pink legs
art.build: Very large, bulky gull, about 70cm, larger and heavier than Vega Gull, among the biggest gulls on the Korean coast; deep chest, flat crown and a fierce expression. Bill long, heavy and deep, about as long as the head, with a marked angle on the lower mandible. Legs fairly long, thick and pink. At rest the white primaries project only a short distance beyond the tail tip, giving a heavy, short-winged rear end. In flight broad wings, pale grey above with all-white primaries and a white trailing edge; no dark wingtips.
avoid: Do not paint black or dark grey wingtips - Vega Gull (Larus vegae) and Slaty-backed Gull have them; this species has pure white primaries.
Do not give it a small rounded head, slim bill and long wingtips far beyond the tail - that is Iceland Gull (Larus glaucoides).
Do not paint yellow legs or a red eye-ring.
Do not darken the back; it is very pale grey, almost white.
